PM
Council Chambers of City Hall

AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING OF NOVEMBER 4, 2024 OF
THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE OF
THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Finance Advisory Committee is requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Finance Advisory Committee minutes preparation.
The Finance Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairperson with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Committee meetings.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES
1.
Meeting of November 29, 2018
Minutes
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
NEW AND OLD BUSINESS
2.
Presentation of FY 2018-19 first quarter financial report and discussion of format and presentation (Staff will present the first quarter financial results. The Committee will discuss the format and presentation of the data.)
3.
Presentation of the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) ending June 30, 2018. (Staff will provide an overview of the CAFR and respond to questions and discussion about the year-end results.)
Staff Report
4.
Discussion of City meeting with Rancho Palos Verdes representatives (The Chair, Vice Chair and staff will share information about what was learned in a meeting with representatives of Rancho Palos Verdes about how their Finance Advisory Committee works, relates to the City Council and staff, and work plan. Committee will discuss perspectives on their scope and responsibilities for moving forward.)
Staff Report
5.
Review and consider the City's Reserve Policy (With the Operations Ad Hoc Committee, staff will present the findings and conclusions of the GFOA Risk Analysis Assessment for the Committee to consider and recommend changes to the City's Reserve Policy.)
Staff Report
6.
Equipment inventory status update (City staff will provide an oral, status update on the City's timeline for completing an inventory of equipment. No action is associated with this item.)
7.
Review and consider GovInvest software for managing the City's CalPERS obligations (The Committee will take action on the CalPERS Ad Hoc recommendation for the GovInvest pension module for projecting, tracking and managing payments to CalPERS.)
Staff Report
8.
Review and discuss the Committee's projections and forecast of the City's finances (The Committee Chair will lead and facilitate a discussion of factors, figures, triggers and information for building and completing a model for projecting the City's future fiscal needs.)
9.
Presentation of OpenGov and discussion of pre-set reports imbedded in the platform (City staff will present the deployment of OpenGov as launched on the City's website, and the Committee will consider other/additional pre-set reports for the ease of the public.)
Staff Report
WRITTEN COMMUNICATION

ADJOURNMENT TO FEBRUARY 28, 2019, AT 6:00 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.

Dated this 31st day of October 2024.Tameka Cook, City Clerk
